pages.title: Transcribe audio to text free, no sign-up | Transcribe
pages.description: Free audio to text transcription with timestamps. Upload an MP3, M4A, WAV or voice note and get the text back. No account, open source, and your audio is never stored.
pages.sub: Drop in a recording and get the text back. Free, no sign-up.

p: Choose a recording, pick the language or leave it on Auto, and press Transcribe. You get the text split into short segments, each with the time it starts, ready to copy or download as a .txt file.
The transcription is done by Whisper large-v3-turbo, an open speech recognition model, running on a computer I own. Your file is not sent to any other company.
There is no account and no paid plan. Each person can transcribe 3 files per hour, up to 3 hours and 100 MB each.

Your audio is deleted the moment the transcript is produced. Transcripts are saved in your own browser, not on the server. The project is open source, so anyone can read the code and confirm it. See the privacy page for the details.

faq.a: Yes. It runs on my own computer, so there is no bill per minute of audio. If it saves you time you can buy me a coffee, but nothing is locked behind a payment.
English and Spanish are the ones I test. On Auto, Whisper detects the language by itself and handles many others, with accuracy that varies by language.
A one-hour recording usually takes a few minutes. Files are transcribed one at a time, so at busy moments you wait in a short line and the page tells you your place.
Yes, and it needs no key. See the API docs. People who donate get a key with 30 transcriptions per hour.

pages.title: MP3 to text: free online transcription with timestamps
pages.description: Convert an MP3 to text for free. Upload the file and get a transcript with timestamps to copy or download. No sign-up, and the MP3 is deleted after it is transcribed.
pages.sub: Upload an MP3 and get a transcript with timestamps. Free, no sign-up.

p: Interviews, lectures, podcasts and meeting recordings usually end up as MP3 files. Drop one above and you get the full text, split into segments with the time each one starts, so you can jump back to the right spot in the recording.

MP3 files of up to 100 MB are accepted, which is about 3 hours of speech at a typical podcast bitrate. If your file is larger, exporting it as mono at 64 kbps keeps speech clear and makes it much smaller.

faq.q: Do I need to convert the MP3 first?
faq.a: No. Upload the MP3 as it is.

faq.q: Can I get the result as a text file?
faq.a: Yes. Use the download button on the transcript to save a .txt file, or the copy button to paste it somewhere else.
It is deleted as soon as the transcript is produced. Nothing is stored on the server; see the privacy page.

pages.title: M4A to text: transcribe iPhone recordings free
pages.description: Transcribe M4A files to text for free. Works with iPhone Voice Memos and other M4A recordings. Timestamps included, no sign-up, audio deleted after transcription.
pages.sub: Transcribe M4A recordings, including iPhone Voice Memos. Free, no sign-up.

p: M4A is the format iPhones and Macs use for Voice Memos, and many call recorders use it too. Drop the file above and you get the text with timestamps, without converting it to MP3 first.
On an iPhone, open Voice Memos, tap the recording, tap the three dots and choose Save to Files. Then choose that file here.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. The page works in the phone's browser and you can pick the recording from your files.

faq.q: How long can the recording be?
faq.a: Up to 3 hours and 100 MB per file.
No. It is deleted right after it is transcribed, and the transcript is saved only in your browser.

pages.title: Voice memo to text: free transcription, no app needed

pages.sub: Turn a voice memo into text in your browser. Free, no app to install.

sections.h: From a voice memo to written notes
p: Recording a thought is quick; finding it again later is not. Upload the memo above and you get text you can search, copy into your notes or send to someone.
It works with recordings from iPhone Voice Memos, Android recorder apps and most other recorders, since they save M4A, MP3, WAV or OGG files.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. It runs in the browser on a phone or a computer.

faq.q: Can it handle a long memo?
faq.a: Yes, up to 3 hours and 100 MB per file.
Nobody. A program transcribes it on my own computer and the file is deleted right after. The code is public if you want to check.

pages.title: WhatsApp voice message to text: free transcription
pages.description: Convert a WhatsApp voice message to text for free. Share or export the audio, upload it here and read it instead of listening. No sign-up, nothing stored.
pages.sub: Read a voice message instead of listening to it. Free, no sign-up.

sections.h: How to transcribe a WhatsApp voice message
p: In WhatsApp, press and hold the voice message, choose Share (or Forward, then Share on iPhone) and save it to your files. Then choose that file above. WhatsApp voice messages are OPUS or OGG files, and both are accepted as they are.
This is handy for long messages when you cannot listen, or when you need to quote exactly what was said.

faq.q: Does this connect to my WhatsApp account?
faq.a: No. You upload only the audio file you choose. The site never sees your chats or contacts.

faq.q: Does it work with messages in Spanish?
faq.a: Yes. Pick Spanish, or leave it on Auto.
No. It is deleted as soon as the transcript is produced.

pages.title: Privacy: what happens to your audio | Transcribe
pages.description: Exactly what Transcribe keeps: nothing. Audio is deleted after transcription, transcripts stay in your browser, there are no accounts, cookies or trackers, and the code is public.
pages.sub: Your audio is deleted after transcription. The details are below.

p: Your file is uploaded to a computer I own, written to a temporary file, transcribed by a program running on that same computer, and deleted the moment the job ends, whether it worked or failed. Any leftover temporary file is also wiped each time the service starts.

The transcript is held in memory for up to one hour so your browser can fetch it, then it is dropped. It is never written to disk on the server. The copy you see in the Library is saved in your own browser and you can delete it there.

sections.h: What is and is not collected
p: There are no accounts, no cookies, no analytics scripts and no requests to other companies from this page; the font and every script are served from this site.

To enforce the limit of 3 transcriptions per hour, the server remembers your IP address in memory for one hour. It is not written to a log. The site is delivered through Cloudflare, which carries the traffic as it does for a large part of the web.
If you donate and claim an API key, the server stores a one-way hash of your email next to the key, not the email itself.
I am not interested in your data. The project is open source so you do not have to take my word for it: read the code.

pages.sub: Sube una grabación y recibe el texto. Gratis y sin registro.

p: Elige una grabación, selecciona el idioma o déjalo en Auto, y presiona Transcribir. Recibes el texto dividido en segmentos cortos, cada uno con el momento en que empieza, listo para copiar o descargar como archivo .txt.
La transcripción la hace Whisper large-v3-turbo, un modelo abierto de reconocimiento de voz, en una computadora mía. Tu archivo no se envía a ninguna otra empresa.

sections.h: Gratis, y no se guarda nada
p: No hay cuenta ni plan de pago. Cada persona puede transcribir 3 archivos por hora, de hasta 3 horas y 100 MB cada uno.

Tu audio se borra en el momento en que se genera la transcripción. Las transcripciones se guardan en tu propio navegador, no en el servidor. El proyecto es de código abierto, así que cualquiera puede leer el código y confirmarlo. Los detalles están en la página de privacidad.

faq.a: Sí. Funciona en mi propia computadora, así que no pago por minuto de audio. Si te ahorra tiempo puedes invitarme un café, pero nada está bloqueado detrás de un pago.
Español e inglés son los que pruebo. En Auto, Whisper detecta el idioma por sí solo y maneja muchos más, con una precisión que varía según el idioma.
Una grabación de una hora suele tardar unos minutos. Los archivos se transcriben uno a la vez, así que en momentos de mucho uso esperas en una fila corta y la página te dice tu lugar.

pages.title: Privacidad: qué pasa con tu audio | Transcribe
pages.description: Exactamente lo que Transcribe guarda: nada. El audio se borra al transcribirse, las transcripciones quedan en tu navegador, no hay cuentas, cookies ni rastreadores, y el código es público.
pages.sub: Tu audio se borra después de transcribirse. Los detalles están abajo.

p: Tu archivo se sube a una computadora mía, se escribe en un archivo temporal, lo transcribe un programa en esa misma computadora, y se borra en el momento en que termina el trabajo, haya funcionado o no. Cualquier archivo temporal que quede también se elimina cada vez que el servicio arranca.

La transcripción se mantiene en memoria hasta una hora para que tu navegador pueda recogerla, y después se descarta. Nunca se escribe en disco en el servidor. La copia que ves en la Biblioteca se guarda en tu propio navegador y ahí mismo la puedes borrar.

sections.h: Qué se recopila y qué no
p: No hay cuentas, ni cookies, ni scripts de analítica, ni peticiones a otras empresas desde esta página; la tipografía y todos los scripts se sirven desde este sitio.

Para aplicar el límite de 3 transcripciones por hora, el servidor recuerda tu dirección IP en memoria durante una hora. No se escribe en ningún registro. El sitio se entrega a través de Cloudflare, que transporta el tráfico como lo hace para gran parte de la web.
Si donas y pides una clave de API, el servidor guarda un hash irreversible de tu correo junto a la clave, no el correo.
No me interesan tus datos. El proyecto es de código abierto para que no tengas que creerme: lee el código.
